kappa.label: kappa
kappa.role: odd central element of A = V + C K + C kappa; formal first-order parameter of the inhomogeneous deformation (Schema 2)

K.label: K
K.role: even central element; may appear as target label "K" in Schema 2-4 records

central_elements.pbw_position: kappa < [odd] < [even]; K is excluded from the PBW basis

odd_map_f.parameterization: f(Z_j) = sum_i phi_<i>_<j> Z_i with p(Z_i) != p(Z_j), plus phiK_<j> K for odd Z_j; indices are basis indices in basis.pbw_order (odd first, 0-based)

reference.name: canonical_gb
reference.definition: f_can(X) = kappa-coefficient of X(a~, b) where a~_1^sigma = a_1^sigma - kappa c^sigma, c^sigma = sum_k ( gb_{a_1^sigma,b_k^-} b_k^+ - gb_{a_1^sigma,b_k^+} b_k^- )

closed_form.odd generators: f_can(a_1^sigma b_k^u) = - c^sigma b_k^u   (normal-ordered; constants -> K)

reference.property: gamma = delta f_can for every gb (see I07/I08 Response)
